title: from_content_returns_err_for_empty_username lacks message content assertion
description: store.rs:from_content_returns_err_for_empty_username checks matches!(err, CredentialStoreError::EmptyUsername{..}) but never asserts on err.to_string() content. The parallel test for MalformedLine does assert the message. Inconsistent pattern — a future contributor changing the Display format for EmptyUsername won't get a failing test, breaking the contract that error messages are tested.
